rows.verifier: FABLE-VT3 (independent — built none of these packets)

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: Alaska Court System form TF-800 (5/25), Request to Make Case Records Confidential or Sealed under Administrative Rule 37.6, route track:AK:ak-tf800, routeSelectionId ak-tf800-set-tf-800-primary-filing; the face names the rule and states the public-records default it is asking the court to displace.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: The single bound source rehashes from the Master Library bytes to the recorded SHA-256 (94bab525…) and byte length, agrees with the committed corpus index and is indexed under state AK; all three packet pages carry that sha.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: requiredComponentsMissing 0; the declared single form TF-800 is the packet, across 3 pages.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: knownRequiredFieldsMissing 0 and requiredFactsNotCollected 0 on my own verifier run in this container, and every one of the 14 values the platform claims to have prefilled is proven present in the finalized fixture bytes (14 of 14 confirmed; invisibleWrites 0). No prefill is asserted by the finalizer alone.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: unclassifiedBlanks 0. The blanks report classifies all of them: 7 REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING (case name, party names, the documents to be restricted, and the log-note details), each carrying why the platform holds no value for it and what the participant must supply in plain words; 3 PROTECTED_FIELD; 11 genuine participant elections.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: requiredOptionsMissing 0. The form's elections — which records, and on what basis — are carried to the participant under 'The choices that are yours' rather than elected by the platform, and no selection mark is drawn in either fixture; the packet elects nothing it does not hold a fact for.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: incompleteRows 0 on my own verifier run: no repeating row on this packet is left half-filled. Where the form carries a multi-row table, the whole table is carried to the participant as required-before-filing blanks rather than partly filled, which is what a zero here means for this family.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: protectedWrites 0 and no refused field carries ink: the clerk's and notary's boxes (the seal, the commission expiry, the JA/Clerk distribution line on page 3) and the whole ORDER on pages 2-3, including the Rule 37.5 findings and the judicial officer's signature, stay empty in the delivered bytes.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Both fixtures rehash to the recorded sha256/byteLength. All 14 writes proven in the bytes; the single boundary row the committed readback reported as mismatched had dropped the U+2019 apostrophe from the participant name, and pdftotext over the boundary fixture finds 'Maria-Alejandra O’Shaughnessy-Whitfield' present verbatim.

reportReadbackDiscrepanciesResolvedAgain.independentByteCheck: expected string present verbatim in fixture bytes via pdftotext

PAGE_ORDER.finding: The page order in the bytes matches the declared manifest across both fixtures: packetPage numbers run 1..n with no gap or repeat, the manifest covers every page pdfinfo counts in the file, each page names the component and document it came from, and each component's source pages stay in their own ascending order.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: visualDefects 0 on my own verifier run; the byte proof reports 0 non-whitespace glyphs outside the measured write boxes in every document and no unfittable value; and the central raster workflow holds a RASTER_PASS for this family whose recorded canonical and boundary sha256 match the bytes I rehashed here.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: 'Where you file this' names the clerk's office of the Alaska trial court where the case is or was pending — the court named in the case number at the top of page 1 — and page 1 of the form carries the same direction.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Named as an open question with the person to ask, rather than guessed: 'Any filing fee, and whether one applies to this request. Ask the clerk of the court above.' No amount is invented.

SERVICE.finding: Stated with the ordering the certificate requires: 'Give a copy to every party in the case, and complete the certificate of service on page 2 after you have done so', with the TrueFiling alternative explained — if the participant and the other parties are on TrueFiling, serve through it. The certificate's date, time, recipient and signature are left blank in the delivered bytes, because service has not happened when the packet is prepared.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Two operative stops, not a disclaimer: the 90-day limit is stated as a precondition to check before filing ('this packet does not compute it for you, because the platform does not hold your case's closing date'), and the form's own redirect is carried — if the case is on public CourtView by mistake because a statute or rule already makes it confidential, the form to use is TF-810, not this one. The packet also states that the judge's public-interest finding is theirs alone.
